choices.why: Its compact black-brown body fits neatly under the small window and gives the sober, modern dark-wood look the user asked for.
An all-black mesh chair with adjustable arms is the truly ergonomic option and matches the desk's dark, sober tone.
Low and wide (160 cm) with a black metal frame, it runs comfortably along the long left wall without overpowering the room.
This black articulated work lamp is functional for the desk and repeats the black of the chair and shelving.
Compact and leather-upholstered, its dark wood frame suits the reading corner and links to the desk and floor.

answer.why: The black, dark-wood palette with a warm touch of leather echoes the dark hardwood floor and stands out against the white walls, making a sober, modern home office.
